engine: markdown
title: "Parquet"
---

```{term}
#| include: false
rush run -o mtcars.csv 'mtcars'
```

Files ending in `.parquet` or `.pq` are read with
[nanoparquet](https://nanoparquet.r-lib.org/), no flags needed. Point
`--output` (`-o`) at a `.parquet` file to write one.

## Reading

```{term}
rush convert -o mtcars.parquet mtcars.csv
rush run 'df |> dplyr::filter(mpg > 25) |> dplyr::select(mpg, cyl, hp)' mtcars.parquet
```

## Writing

Convert CSV to Parquet and read it back:

```{term}
rush run --output mtcars.parquet 'df' mtcars.csv
rush run 'head(df, 3)' mtcars.parquet
```

## With SQL

Because DuckDB reads Parquet natively, large-file queries run without loading
everything into memory:

```{term}
rush sql "SELECT cyl, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(mpg), 1) AS avg_mpg
          FROM mtcars
          GROUP BY cyl
          ORDER BY avg_mpg DESC" mtcars.parquet
```

```{term}
#| include: false
rm -f mtcars.csv mtcars.parquet
```
